 Updated : 16 minutes ago Western Albemarle defeated Albemarle 44-22 in the Game of the Week, a rivalry matchup that stayed close through the first half before the Warriors pulled away in the second.
Western Albemarle traveled to Albemarle County High School for the latest chapter in the rivalry between the two teams. Entering the game, Western had been inconsistent but was beginning to find momentum, while Albemarle was still searching for an identity on the field.
